item.title: Amplitude Energy Commences Gas Flow Testing at Isabella Prospect
item.description: Amplitude Energy kicks off Isabella flow testing after ST-1 gas hit; two weeks to prove commercial viability, shaping ECSP progress and EnergyAustralia GSA.

item.title: Emmerson Resources Agrees to $311m Scrip-Based Takeover by Pan African
item.description: Emmerson Resources agrees to a $311m Pan African scrip takeover at a 36% premium, giving ERM holders ~4.2% of the larger gold producer.

item.title: Island Pharma Expands Antiviral Pipeline with Burnet Institute Collaboration and NHMRC Funding
item.description: Island Pharma expands antiviral pipeline with Burnet Institute; NHMRC grant of over $780k to back ISLA-101, accelerating Galidesivir MVD program.

item.title: BluGlass Lands A$1.25M Defence Program With US Tier-1 Prime Customer
item.description: BluGlass lands A$1.25m GaN laser defence program with US Tier-1 prime; initial A$560k order, 14–20 month milestones, boosts US footprint.

item.title: Chilwa Minerals Confirms Niobium Mineralisation at Mpyupyu Target
item.description: Chilwa Minerals confirms niobium at Mpyupyu, boosting Lake Chilwa’s multi-commodity critical minerals case; best intercept 0.31% Nb2O5 over 126m.

item.title: Pacgold Eyes Near-Term Production as Heap Leach Re-Crush Begins at White Dam Gold Project
item.description: Pacgold kicks off heap leach re-crush at White Dam, eyeing near-term production as assays loom next week; 350 tph circuit on track, weather risks.

item.title: Southern Cross Electrical Lifts FY26 EBITDA Guidance Despite H1 NPAT Loss
item.description: SXE lifts FY26 EBITDA guidance to at least $72m despite H1 NPAT loss of $12.8m from WestConnex costs; cash-rich, no debt, expanding data-centre pipeline.

item.title: Auric Mining Reports Solid Performance from Gold Processing at Munda Starter Pit
item.description: Auric Mining smashed its budget with 8,475oz from Munda across two campaigns; latest outturn 938oz at Lakewood Mill signals strong growth.

item.title: The Weekly Finger: On bruised legs and bruised portfolios
item.description: Oil surges; crude ETF jumps 33% in a week—the biggest weekly gain on record—plus a new Finger on the Pulse episode and a revamped Investor Pulse site.

item.title: Lodestar Minerals Engages Westdrill Ahead of Resource Definition at Ned’s Creek Gold Project
item.description: Lodestar taps Westdrill for 10,000m RC at Ned's Creek to accelerate a maiden resource estimate this year, eyeing up to 300koz from three prospects.
